heights_600m.pixel: difference from the 5 km heights: metres = (R·256 + G − 32768)/2
heights_600m.tiles: cube face f, x, y at the level's 2^level × 2^level grid; (n+1)² samples, edges shared

encoding.rivers_and_surface_600m: rows 0–n: rivers (R, G: offset to the centreline, 128 + 32·samples; B: width; lakes offset 0, B 255); below, at half resolution: wetness, scree, bare rock (R, G, B 0–1)
encoding.rockid: R = unit index × 8 (geology.UNITS order), G = large rivers
